items:
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

Personal protective equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet...etc.
Line isolation is required.

Secondary 
 injection test set,

Clamp ammeter, 
 voltmeter, test leads,

Complete tool set, 
 Test plug

Disconnect 
 the circuit breaker for generator.
Removed the plug of connection for Differential relay.
Put the test plug of connection in Differential relay.

Connect test leads between the test set and the current terminal (5&6) for 
 phase ( R ) in the 
 test plug for the Differential relay.

Connect test leads between the test set and the time terminal (1&2) for 
 phase(R) in the test 
 plug for the Differential relay.

Increase the injected current slowly until the red indication on the 
 Differential element phase 
 ( R ) on the relay appears.

Record this value (of the current and the time) on the test sheet ( adjust 
 it if needed ).
Switch off the test set.

Repeat the above test from step ( 4 ) to ( 7 ) but inject current between 
 terminal ( 5 &6) for 
 phase ( S ) and terminal ( 5&6 ) for phase ( T ) and time terminal (1&2) 
 for phase (S) and 
 terminal (1&2) for phase (T).
Disconnect the test leads from timer terminal on the relay.
Remove the test plug from the relay.
Put the plug of connection for High-Speed Differential relay.

If any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated, it should 
 be returned to service by the following restoration steps:
Breaker trip coil
Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.
Repeat the circuit breaker of the generator to the normal position.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, 
to be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 
in above title block.
This procedure details the steps

 relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases.
The document is formatted the way
